title: REQ · Executions persist as JSON records and startup recovery resumes or marks unfinished ones
summary: State store with a JSON file per execution and a recovery routine run on startup
description: Context: backend execution records are YAML; the worker keeps its own local JSON state. Desired behavior: state.Store saves and loads one JSON file per execution atomically; recovery.Run scans for unfinished executions and releases stale locks. Expected result: after a crash nothing is assumed to be running. Why: the Worker is not continuously running.
acceptance_criteria: Given a saved Execution, when loaded, then all fields round-trip
Given a RUNNING execution with Attempt below max retries, when recovery runs, then it becomes QUEUED (resumed) with an Error note
Given a RUNNING execution with Attempt at max retries, when recovery runs, then it becomes RECOVERING
Given a stale lock owned by a dead process, when recovery runs, then the lock is removed; AWAITING_APPROVAL and COMPLETED records are untouched

preserve: Status names from backend execution package

technical_constraints: Atomic write via temp file and rename; clock and process-liveness injected
definition_of_done: Store and recovery behave as specified
